title: Grade Book
brief: Read a class's scores and print a summary. The first line is the number of students N, followed by N integer scores (one per line).
requirements: Print `Average: X` with two decimal places
Print `Passed: K` where K is the number of scores of 40 or more
starter:
n = int(input())
# read the scores here
solution:
n = int(input())
scores = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]
print(f"Average: {sum(scores) / n:.2f}")
print(f"Highest: {max(scores)}")
print(f"Lowest: {min(scores)}")
print(f"Passed: {sum(1 for s in scores if s >= 40)}")
hints: Store the scores in a list.
sum(), max(), min() and a counting loop help.

title: Text Analyzer
brief: Read one line of text and print statistics about it.
requirements: `Vowels: N` - count of a, e, i, o, u (any case)
`Longest word: W` - the first longest word
`Most common letter: L` - lower-case letters only; ties go to the alphabetically first letter
solution:
text = input()
words = text.split()
letters = [c for c in text.lower() if c.isalpha()]
counts = {}
for c in letters:
    counts[c] = counts.get(c, 0) + 1
best = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[0][0]
longest = max(words, key=len)
print(f"Characters: {len(text)}")
print(f"Words: {len(words)}")
print(f"Vowels: {sum(1 for c in letters if c in 'aeiou')}")
print(f"Longest word: {longest}")
print(f"Most common letter: {best}")

tests.expected:

Words: 4
Vowels: 5
Longest word: quick
Most common letter: o

Characters: 17
Words: 3
Vowels: 5
Longest word: Hello
Most common letter: l

hints: split() gives the words; max(words, key=len) finds the longest.
Count letters in a dictionary, then pick the highest count (alphabetical on ties).
